# Brainstorming — Superpowers

Curated by Skill Harbor — a design-refinement workflow from the Superpowers methodology: start by deeply understanding the goal, build a strong design (YAGNI, single-responsibility, verify assumptions), then present 2–3 concrete approaches with tradeoffs and a recommendation, let the user choose, and only then write the implementation plan. Its hard rules are what make it work — propose the design before building, wait for the user's choice, ask exactly one question when truly blocked. Discovered via skills.sh, listed here with credit to its creator by @obra. Honest caveats: it's a process skill, not a tool — it changes how the agent works, not what it can do; it pairs best with a companion plan-writing workflow for complex builds; if you just want a quick answer, the structured back-and-forth can feel slow. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
